notes.title: Updates Including Newly Added and Improved Stages Announcement (Jan 15)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882933/129e6e51076e4f180aec7257fe89f70024f72188.png[/img]



Hello,

As of 7 P.M., January 15th 2025 (UTC+9), an update has been applied to the Nientum - Opus ZERO demo version.

- Added and improved story content
- Added and improved stages
- Added and refined overall visual effects
- Adjusted unintended note placements causing incorrect difficulty
- Translation improvements
- Resolved various bugs and performance optimizations

Please note that existing play data for those who have already played the demo will be reset.

Thank you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882933/288f2386fab3c88f29b35d895b6802171e2a9522.png[/img]
